topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I just got a call from my best friend, Emily. Well, I guess it was more of a quick chat. She said she needed to talk to me about something important. I could hear a bit of a pause on her end, like she was choosing her words carefully. She told me they, well, everyone, thought they’d planned this big party for me. But something came up, and they decided it wouldn’t be the right time. She said it with this tone, like she was trying really hard to make it sound okay. I just stood there, feeling the weight of the words sinking in. I mean, I was looking forward to it, you know? But hey, I get it. Things happen. I guess I’ll just have to plan my own celebration now.
